description_ru: Юмористический рассказ о кошке Пудинг, которая установила в доме свои правила: подъём в пять утра, выбор еды, диван и ванна.
text:
When we adopted a cat three years ago, I thought that we were the ones in charge. The animal shelter had shown us a small grey creature called Pudding, who looked at us with big green eyes and made a tiny noise like a squeaky door. My wife and I fell in love at once. "She will be so happy with us," I said on the way home. Looking back, I realise that she was not asking for a home. She was interviewing us for a job.

The first night, Pudding walked around our flat with her tail in the air, inspecting every room like a manager on a tour. She jumped on the kitchen table, looked at the bread bin, and knocked a glass onto the floor. It was not an accident. She looked straight at me while she did it. Then she walked into the bedroom, chose the middle of the bed and fell asleep, leaving us with a space about thirty centimetres wide. I slept on the edge that night, and I have slept on the edge ever since.

It did not take long to discover that Pudding has a strict timetable. At five o'clock in the morning she sits on my chest and stares at my face until I wake up. If this does not work, she taps my nose with her paw, very gently, like someone knocking on a door. If I still refuse to get up, she walks to the dressing table and slowly pushes a bottle of perfume towards the edge. I have learned that it is cheaper to feed her at five than to buy a new bottle every week.

Breakfast is a serious matter, too. Pudding will only eat one brand of cat food, which costs twice as much as my own lunch. She also has opinions about the flavour. On Monday she loves the chicken, and on Tuesday she thinks that chicken is disgusting, and she will sit next to the bowl with an expression of deep disappointment until I offer fish. Once, when I tried to buy a cheaper brand, she did not eat for two days. She simply watched me from the sofa, and I felt so guilty that I went back to the shop that evening.

Then there are the rules of the sofa. Every house has an unofficial set of laws, and Pudding makes ours. The best seat, near the window, belongs to her. If a visitor sits there, she jumps up beside the person and stares until they move. My mother-in-law, who is not a cat person, once refused to give way, and Pudding sat on her handbag for the whole afternoon. When the visit was over, the handbag was covered in grey hair, and my mother-in-law has not mentioned the sofa since.

The cat also has a very strong view on privacy, which is that she has a right to ours and we have none of hers. I have not had a quiet bath for three years. As soon as I run the water, there is a scratching at the door, followed by a loud, sad voice that seems to ask how I could be so cruel. If I open the door, she walks in, sits on the edge of the bath and watches me as if I were a television programme. Occasionally she puts a paw in the water, shakes it and looks at me with disgust, as if I had put it there.

Of course, she can be wonderful, too. When I came home after a terrible day at work last winter, she curled up on my lap and made the soft rumbling sound that cats make when they are happy. I forgot all my problems. She also keeps the flat free of mice, although I should explain that she brings the mice into the bedroom first, to show them to us. Last month my wife woke up to find a small grey visitor in her slipper, and I have never seen her run so fast.

Friends often ask whether we are going to get a second cat. My wife says yes, but I am not sure. If we brought home another animal, I think that Pudding would organise a meeting, vote against it and leave the room. Besides, there is hardly any space left in the bed. For the moment, I have accepted my position in the family. I am the person who opens cans, who carries the bags and who sleeps on the edge. It is not a bad job, and the cat, I have to admit, is excellent at supervision.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка слегка между зубами, воздух проходит без голоса; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».
Спинка языка прижата к нёбу, звук идёт через нос; в конце -ing не добавляйте «г».
Губы округлены и вытянуты вперёд, зубов не касаются; это не русское «в».
Звонкие согласные в конце слова не оглушайте: «had» — не «хат», «bed» — не «бет».

questions.question: At what time does the cat wake the narrator?
questions.answer: At five o'clock in the morning.

questions.question: What does the cat do if the narrator does not get up?
questions.answer: She taps his nose and pushes a bottle of perfume towards the edge.

questions.question: What happened when the mother-in-law sat on the cat's seat?
questions.answer: The cat sat on her handbag for the whole afternoon.

questions.question: Why is a second cat not a good idea?
questions.answer: The narrator thinks the cat would vote against it and there is little space in the bed.
